neighbours.label: bodily suffering or failing health in narrative (pain in his limbs, tears in his eyes, her health failed, collapse)
fire: By the third night the ache in her back was so bad that she could not lie down.
He limped off the field clutching his knee, with tears in his eyes.
In the last winter of his life his strength failed and he rarely left his bed.
After the long march several soldiers fainted from exhaustion and thirst.
The fever left her weak, and the pain in her joints lasted for weeks.
Her eyesight slowly faded until she could no longer read her letters.
The old dog's legs gave way on the stairs, and he whimpered in pain.
During the heatwave two runners collapsed near the finish line and were taken away.
quiet: By the third night the noise in the street was so loud that she could not sleep.
He jogged off the field holding the ball, with a grin on his face.
In the last winter of his life he wrote letters to all his old friends.
After the long march several soldiers sang songs around the campfire.
The holiday left her rested, and the photos from the beach lasted for years.
Her garden slowly grew until it covered most of the back yard.
The old dog's tail wagged on the stairs, and he barked at the postman.
During the heatwave two runners crossed the finish line together and hugged.

notes: Weak pole (max 4.5). Card top examples: 'The pain in his limbs', 'tears in his eyes', 'her health failed', 'may include collapse', German 'Schmerzen ... Tendenz', Arabic osteoporosis text.
